subject: Trial orchestration / ownership & clearance items
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.inference>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@greenglobe.ai>
Cc: Marco Rossi <marco.rossi@greencloud.it>, aditya_rao@redwood.inference, monica_patel@redwood.inference
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Trial orchestration / ownership & clearance items

Hi Olivia — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the POC started: 

Summary of goals (agreed on call)
- Validate latency and cost at your 25–50 concurrent-user profile
- Verify embedding/semantic search quality on 3 production prompt sets
- Confirm security posture (DLP, minimal data retention, audit logs)

Proposed trial plan (attached: redwood-poc-plan.xlsx)
- Sandbox window: 4 weeks (target kickoff: Mon Mar 28)
- Environment: Dedicated sandbox VPC (no production peering)
- Deliverables: baseline perf report, embedding quality report, operational runbook

Ownership / RACI (draft)
- Infra (sandbox VPC, network checks): Marco Rossi (GreenGlobe IT) — action: confirm egress rules and SIEM reachable IPs
- App integration / test harness: Olivia (Product) + GreenGlobe dev lead (TBD)
- Security review / compliance evidence: Procurement & Security team (procurement@greenglobe.ai) — need SOC2 reports and DPA countersign
- Redwood delivery: Sofia (commercial lead) + Ben Carter (integration engineer) — Ben will own environment provisioning and test dataset ingestion
- Success criteria measurement: Monica Patel (CS) — will run evaluation scripts and collect metrics

Immediate asks from you by EOD Mon (Mar 22):
1) Confirm the infra owner (Marco OK?) and provide a contact for the dev lead we should pair with for the app integration
2) Confirm procurement timeline and any required legal contacts for DPA/SOC2 
3) If there are any additional compliance checks (SIEM/IDS integration), flag now so we can size the setup

Next steps I will take
- Share the POC plan and a one-page runbook (attached)
- Ben will spin up the sandbox templates once Marco confirms networking
- Schedule a 30-min kickoff for Mon Mar 28 (proposed: 10:00 CET)

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-poc-plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Thanks — happy to adjust based on your timeline.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.inference
+44 20 7946 0123
From: Olivia Chen <olivia@greenglobe.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marco Rossi <marco.rossi@greencloud.it>, procurement@greenglobe.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:18:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Trial orchestration / ownership & clearance items

Sofia — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Owners: Marco is infra lead (confirmed). For app integration, our lead is Andrea Lucini (andrea.lucini@greencloud.it) — please loop him for the test harness details.
2) Security / procurement: procurement@greenglobe.ai will own the DPA/SOC2 review. They need a short security pack; can you provide a single PDF with SOC2 section + data handling notes?
3) SIEM: our SecOps requires that the sandbox expose logs to a collector endpoint (we'll give an IP range). They also want to validate RBAC and token rotation for the trial.

Timeline: procurement expects a 10–14 day review once we send the security pack. So kickoff likely Mar 28 only if procurement can start parallel with infra. If procurement can't start until the contract is in place, we may push the sandbox to Apr 4.

I attached our security questionnaire answers where helpful.

Attachments: [Attachment: security-qa.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks — looping Andrea and Marco.

Best,
Olivia Chen
Head of Product — GreenGlobe Energy
olivia@greenglobe.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@greenglobe.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marco Rossi <marco.rossi@greencloud.it>, aditya_rao@redwood.inference
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial orchestration / ownership & clearance items

Hi all — Ben from Redwood engineering here. Quick technical notes and a proposed checklist for environment provisioning: 

Technical checklist (what I need from Marco / Andrea)
- VPC CIDR and allowed egress IPs for SIEM collector
- SSH bastion or VPN requirement (we support both; for sandbox we recommend managed VPN)
- Test dataset: a 1000-record anonymized set (we can ingest JSONL) — please let me know if you prefer S3 or secure upload link
- Expected max prompt length & concurrency (Sofia mentioned 25–50 concurrent users; confirm average prompt length so we tune batching)

Provisioning plan
- I will create a sandbox stack from env-template.yaml (attached). This includes a private VPC, NAT, and a dedicated Redwood worker pool (quantized model variant) — estimated provisioning time: 6–12 hours after we get network details.
- I'll pre-seed the KV caches with a small vector index to speed first-run queries.

Acceptance gates (engineering)
- Environment reachable from GreenGlobe test IPs
- Baseline perf: 95th p50 < 450ms for standard prompts at target concurrency (we'll measure)
- No PII persisted beyond 24h (configurable TTL)

Attachment: [Attachment: env-template.yaml (text/x-yaml)]

If procurement needs SOC2 artifacts, let me know the preferred format and I'll pull the relevant export.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia@greenglobe.ai>, Marco Rossi <marco.rossi@greencloud.it>, procurement@greenglobe.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial orchestration / ownership & clearance items

Thanks team — pulling this together. A couple of clarifications and commitments from Redwood: 

Commercial / gating items (Redwood commit)
- We will share a one-page SOC2 + DPA summary by EOD Tue (Mar 23) to start procurement review in parallel with infra.
- Ben will start templating the sandbox as soon as Marco confirms network egress (target before end of day Wed Mar 23).
- Monica: please own the success-criteria dashboard and confirm the evaluation scripts by Fri Mar 25. Monica, I'll add you to the Drive folder.

Rollout gating & canary plan
- Canary workload: 10% of target concurrency for 48 hours to verify perf and log export. Canary must pass perf and logging before we open full sandbox.
- If procurement needs in-environment review (SecOps live check), we will allocate a 1-hour window during the canary for SecOps inspection.

Action items (owner + due)
- Marco: provide egress IP range + team contact (due: Wed Mar 23)
- Olivia/Andrea: confirm test harness owner + share sample dataset format (due: Wed Mar 23)
- Procurement: confirm timeline for SOC2/DPA review (procurement@greenglobe.ai)
- Ben: stand up env template once network details received (due: Thu Mar 24)
- Monica: confirm eval scripts & dashboard (due: Fri Mar 25)

If procurement can start review with the SOC2 summary, we should be on track for a Mar 28 kickoff with a light canary; otherwise we shift to Apr 4.

I'll follow up after we get Marco's details. Thanks all.

—
Aditya Rao
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.inference
